category: 🍷 Alcohol BAC Limits, DUI Penalties & Legal Escalations

items.label: Administrative Fine Threshold
items.value: Breath BAC ≥ 0.15 mg/L (or Blood ≥ 0.03%) → NT$15,000–$90,000 + 1–2 yr license suspension

items.label: Criminal Prosecution Threshold
items.value: Breath BAC ≥ 0.25 mg/L (or Blood ≥ 0.05%) → Criminal Code 185-3 prosecution + prison

items.label: Repeat DUI Offense (within 10 years)
items.value: 2nd time: NT$90,000 + previous fine; 3rd time: previous + NT$90,000 + vehicle impounded

items.label: DUI Breathalyzer Refusal
items.value: Instant NT$180,000 fine + driver license REVOKED + vehicle impounded + safety training

items.label: DUI Passenger Liability (Aged 18+)
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$15,000 fine for passengers in the same vehicle

items.label: Owner Allowing Drunk Driver to Operate
items.value: Same monetary fine as driver + vehicle license plate suspended for 2 years

items.label: DUI Crash Causing Serious Injury or Death
items.value: Permanent driver license revocation + vehicle confiscated

items.label: Ignition Interlock Device Requirement
items.value: Required for 1 year after DUI license reinstatement; driving unequipped = NT$60,000–120,000

category: 📋 License Actions, Suspensions, Revocations & Reapplication Bans

items.label: Lending Driver's License to Another Person
items.value: 3-month driver's license suspension

items.label: Lending Vehicle to Unlicensed Driver
items.value: 3-month driver's license suspension for vehicle owner

items.label: Forged, Altered, or Counterfeit License
items.value: NT$6,000–$24,000 fine + physical license CONFISCATED immediately

items.label: Cheating / Registering Dishonestly on Exam
items.value: 5-year ban from retaking driver's license test

items.label: Failed Motorcycle Road/Written Test
items.value: Must wait at least 7 days before retaking test

items.label: Hit-and-Run without Injury (Property only)
items.value: NT$1,000–$3,000 fine + driver's license suspended for 1 to 3 months

items.label: Hit-and-Run with Injury to Others
items.value: Driver's license REVOKED + banned from reapplying for 1 to 3 years

items.label: Hit-and-Run with Serious Injury or Death
items.value: Driver's license REVOKED + PERMANENT lifetime ban from retaking test

items.label: Disqualified Physical Fitness / Medical Changes
items.value: Must voluntarily return driver's license to Motor Vehicle Office

items.label: Solid Red Line Curb (Red curb marking)
items.value: Temporary stopping and parking PROHIBITED 24 hours a day

items.label: Solid Yellow Line Curb (Yellow curb marking)
items.value: No parking 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM daily; brief stop ≤ 3 min allowed with driver ready

items.label: Yellow Diagonal Cross Grid Lines
items.value: Prohibits all temporary stopping inside intersection/gate area

items.label: Distance from Fire Hydrants / Fire Station Exits
items.value: No parking or stopping within 5 meters

items.label: Distance from Intersections & Bus Stops
items.value: No stopping or parking within 10 meters

items.label: Distance from Railway Level Crossings
items.value: No stopping or parking within 10 meters

items.label: Direct Citation Consecutive Parking Interval
items.value: Citations may be issued every 2 hours if vehicle remains unmoved

category: 🩺 Emergency Trauma First Aid & CPR Protocol

items.label: CPR Compressions-to-Breaths Ratio
items.value: 30 compressions to 2 rescue breaths (30:2) for all solo adult rescues

items.label: Chest Compression Depth (Adult)
items.value: At least 5 cm, not exceeding 6 cm

items.label: Chest Compression Rate
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute

items.label: Breathing Assessment Window
items.value: Minimum 5 seconds, Maximum 10 seconds

items.label: Emergency CPR Sequence (Call-Call-C-A-B-D)
items.value: 1. Call patient → 2. Call 119/AED → 3. Compressions → 4. Airway → 5. Breathing → 6. Defibrillation

items.label: Compression Hand Position
items.value: Lower half of sternum / center of chest between nipples

items.label: Heimlich Maneuver Hand Placement
items.value: Slightly above the navel, well below xiphoid process

items.label: Trauma Victim in Shock Symptoms
items.value: Pale, cool, clammy skin with rapid weak pulse

items.label: Bright Red Blood Spurting Continuously
items.value: Arterial bleeding → Requires direct pressure / tourniquet immediately

items.label: Unconscious Victim with Normal Breathing
items.value: Place in Recovery Position to keep airway clear

items.label: White Diamond Road Marking
items.value: Pedestrian crosswalk ahead; slow down and prepare to yield

items.label: Double Solid Yellow Line
items.value: Directional separation line; strictly prohibits crossing, overtaking, or U-turns

items.label: Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook Turn )
items.value: Mandatory when: 1. Inner lane marked No-Moto, or 2. Hook turn sign posted, or 3. ≥3 fast lanes

items.label: Entering Multi-Lane Road Left Turn
items.value: Must enter innermost lane after crossing; do not cut abruptly across lanes

items.label: Uncontrolled Intersection Priority
items.value: 1. Branch yields to Main → 2. Left-turn yields to Straight → 3. Left vehicle yields to Right vehicle

items.label: Roundabout (Traffic Circle) Priority
items.value: Vehicles outside the circle MUST yield to vehicles already inside the circle

items.label: Steep Slope Meeting Rule
items.value: Downhill vehicle yields to uphill vehicle; unless downhill is already midway through

items.label: Compulsory Insurance Certificate Validity
items.value: Must have at least 30 days remaining validity for title transfer/inspection

items.label: Motorcycle Over 5 Years Old Ownership Transfer
items.value: Mandatory temporary inspection before ownership transfer

items.label: Motorcycle Temporarily Out of Service Max Period
items.value: Maximum allowed suspension period is 1 year

items.label: Public Traffic Violation Reporting Time Limit
items.value: Must be reported within 7 days of the violation date

items.label: Motorcycle Stolen Fuel Fee Cutoff
items.value: Charged up to one day before the police theft report date

items.label: Exhaust Pipe Modification Standard
items.value: Must NOT alter number/position; catalytic converter and muffler MUST NOT be removed
